name: CG-Bench
intro: CG-Bench是一个针对长视频理解中线索溯源问答的新型基准测试。它旨在解决现有基准主要关注短视频或依赖多项选择题的局限性，这些局限性可能导致模型在没有真正理解视频内容的情况下给出答案。CG-Bench强调模型检索相关线索的能力，包含1,219个手动策划的视频和12,129个问答对，涵盖感知、推理和幻觉三种主要问题类型。该基准还引入了线索溯源的白盒和黑盒评估方法，以全面评估模型对长视频的理解能力。
org: Nanjing University, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Fudan University, Zhejiang University
build_method: 长视频人工采集与七轮筛选, QAC与时间线索标注, 人工/GPT-4/MLLM/分布四项全部通过门与失败返修
metric: long-acc., clue-acc., mIoU, rec.@IoU, acc.@IoU, CRR, Open-ended Accuracy
task_type: 长视频多选问答, 时间线索定位, 可信度评测, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 完整视频/线索片段对照, 白盒时间定位, 黑盒CRR, 线索辅助GPT-4o开放问答
scale: 1,219个长视频, 12,129个QAC三元组, 14,362个线索区间
build_method_en: Manual long-video collection and seven-round review, QAC/clue annotation, then an all-pass manual/GPT-4/MLLM/distribution gate with revision on any failure
eval_feature_en: Full-video/Clue-clip Contrast, White-box Temporal Grounding, Black-box CRR, Clue-aided GPT-4o Open-ended QA
intro_en: CG-Bench is a novel benchmark for clue tracing question answering in long video understanding. It addresses the limitations of existing benchmarks that mainly focus on short videos or rely on multiple-choice questions, which may lead models to answer without truly understanding the video content. CG-Bench emphasizes models' ability to retrieve relevant clues and includes 1,219 manually curated videos and 12,129 QA pairs, covering three main question types: perception, reasoning, and hallucination. The benchmark also introduces white-box and black-box clue tracing evaluation methods to comprehensively assess models' understanding of long videos.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW. Reviewed against arXiv:2412.12075v1 §3.1 and official repository commit f826608752443a13b21f214c2d9c4156c526f030. The diagram replaces the incorrect parallel-QC merge with the paper's conjunctive gate: manual rationality review, GPT-4 text-only-answerability rejection, MLLM sparse-frame/small-model-easy rejection, and clue-duration/position distribution monitoring must all pass. Any failed condition loops back for revision before release. The four evaluation branches preserve full-video/clue MCQ, white-box temporal grounding, black-box CRR, and clue-aided GPT-4o open QA.
